mutants.description: Inverts sensor error check in main. Success branch jumps to error logging; error branch attempts to read temperature.
mutants.detection_criteria: Transmits 'Error' instead of formatted telemetry on valid sensor reads

mutants.description: Sets main loop HAL_Delay duration from 2000 ms to 0 ms, flooding the UART bus without inter-frame delay.
mutants.detection_criteria: UART transmission rate exceeds 2000 ms period or runs continuously

mutants.description: Replaces 'subs r0, #6' with 'adds r0, #6' in Si7021 RH formula, corrupting relative humidity calculation by +12% RH.
mutants.detection_criteria: Reported relative humidity exceeds physical upper bound (100% RH) or shifts by +12%

mutants.description: Zeroes the 125 multiplier in Si7021 RH formula (movs r0, #0), collapsing computed relative humidity to -6%.
mutants.detection_criteria: Reported humidity is -6%, violating lower physical bound (0% RH)

mutants.description: Changes Si7021 temperature read command from 0xE0 to invalid command 0xFF, triggering I2C NACK / sensor transaction failure.
mutants.detection_criteria: Temperature reading fails (returns 0xFFFF) or triggers error frame
